# Blades, Wills and Haki

[All quest chapters](index.md)

<a id="q-1a15037751d1c7b9"></a>

## Three Paths of Steel

Curses, blackening and Zoan infusion are separate weapon paths. A cursed blade cannot become black or infused; black and infused blades are mutually exclusive on these weapon paths.

Use different weapons to explore different paths. The Black Fist route is independent and accepts Brawler or Black Leg.

Curse acquisition branches are optional and visible from here. World curse limits may prevent a new curse from forming.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Romance Dawn](01_romance_dawn.md#q-3701db37ab2d99d1)

**Tasks**

- I understand the separate weapon paths

<a id="q-59c67aeb575d3c63"></a>

## A Blade with a Will

Carry any genuinely cursed blade. Curse-related counters alone do not count.

To awaken a curse: at least 3,000 Doriki and sword attack damage 7; lore swords have special eligibility. Curses may be scarce in the world.

The ten optional branches explain each origin. You only need one curse type for this main path.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Three Paths of Steel](special_weapons.md#q-1a15037751d1c7b9)

**Tasks**

- Carry a cursed blade

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000

<a id="q-2ce58940861dbf0b"></a>

## The Test of Fate

Sneak and use the cursed blade to take the Test of Fate. Success must name YOU as its bearer.

Luck improves your chance of success. Failure hurts and prevents another attempt for a while. Recover before trying again.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [A Blade with a Will](special_weapons.md#q-59c67aeb575d3c63)

**Tasks**

- Be accepted as a cursed blade bearer

**Rewards**

- Doriki +210, Belly +8,500

<a id="q-355356c91755d516"></a>

## Whispering Steel

Carry an accepted cursed blade with at least one tenth of the blood needed for level II, or a blade already level II or higher.

Strong opponents feed the curse. Easy prey does not.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [The Test of Fate](special_weapons.md#q-2ce58940861dbf0b)

**Tasks**

- Accepted blade: 10% of level II blood or higher level

**Rewards**

- Doriki +210, Belly +8,500

<a id="q-7876314322cacdea"></a>

## Raging Curse

Carry a cursed blade at level 2 or higher that recognizes you as bearer.

Actual curse level determines completion, not a quest kill counter. You may use any curse type.

## Misfortune — Origin

**Optional quest.**

Origins: wield Sandai Kitetsu or Nidai Kitetsu (lore curse), or let the SAME sword pass through 3 different players who die holding it, killed by enemies. Falls and the void do not count.

Use an eligible sword, build your strength, and follow the origin described above. A new curse cannot form while all available places are occupied.

Carry a blade with the Misfortune curse. This quest recognizes possession, not proof that you personally performed its origin. The blade is not consumed.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Three Paths of Steel](special_weapons.md#q-1a15037751d1c7b9)

**Tasks**

- Carry a Misfortune blade

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000

## Devouring — Origin

**Optional quest.**

Origins: wield Enma (lore curse), or a failed Black Blade forging ritual has a 15% chance to curse the blade instead. Obtain the actual curse; a failed ritual alone is not enough.

Carry a blade with the Devouring curse. This quest recognizes possession, not proof that you personally performed its origin. The blade is not consumed.

## Bloodthirst — Origin

**Optional quest.**

Origin: with the same sword, complete 3 massacres on different in-game days. Each is 10 innocents within 120 seconds. Villagers, wandering traders, other players' pets and much weaker players can count. This is an optional dark path, never required by the main story.

Use an eligible sword, build your strength, and follow the origin described above. A new curse cannot form while all available places are occupied.

Carry a blade with the Bloodthirst curse. This quest recognizes possession, not proof that you personally performed its origin. The blade is not consumed.

## The Will Behind the Edge

Earn positive Black Blade progress on an eligible, uncursed, uninfused weapon. Keep Busoshoku Imbuing active and attack qualifying enemies.

Train Busoshoku and fight strong opponents with Imbuing active. A blade already turned black qualifies too.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Three Paths of Steel](special_weapons.md#q-1a15037751d1c7b9)

**Tasks**

- Carry a blade with BlackHaki progress

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000

<a id="q-200cb50eae6f2d04"></a>

## The Kokuto Forge

Obtain a Kokuto Forge and Kokuto Whetstone. These tasks do not consume either item.

For the forging ritual: 70 Busoshoku experience, a blade at least halfway to forging progress, and a Whetstone. Stay near the forge with Imbuing active and avoid damage for the ritual.

Ordinary combat can also forge a blade; later ranks normally require forge trials.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [The Will Behind the Edge](special_weapons.md#q-308231c423a98f28)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +210, Belly +8,500

<a id="q-1eb197ffda854ee3"></a>

Train through qualifying combat, then face the trials at a Kokuto Forge.

## No Weapon Required

With your main hand empty, use Busoshoku Hardening in qualifying combat to earn Black Fist progress.

Main-hand emptiness, Hardening, Haki eligibility and target strength are handled by BlackHaki. This quest does not award timed training or free progress.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [The Unarmed Path](special_weapons.md#q-1e595f5065e03270)

**Tasks**

- Earn Black Fist progress

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000

<a id="q-64197ed8676b0926"></a>

## The First Black Fist

Attain Black Fist rank 1 or higher while using Brawler or Black Leg.

## A Weapon with Potential

Carry an uninfused weapon with Zoan affinity. A weapon whose tooltip says No Zoan Affinity does not qualify.

Black Blades and cursed blades are separate paths; choose another weapon for infusion.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Three Paths of Steel](special_weapons.md#q-1a15037751d1c7b9)

**Tasks**

- Carry an eligible uninfused affinity weapon

**Rewards**

- Doriki +90, Belly +2,000

<a id="q-30665e46db07dcbe"></a>

## A Fruit for the Forge

Carry an eligible affinity weapon and a Zoan Devil Fruit supported by Infusion. Neither is consumed by the quest.

Use the actual infusion procedure when ready: drop the weapon and supported fruit together. The mod consumes the fruit. Respect server One Fruit rules.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [A Weapon with Potential](special_weapons.md#q-5e7bbbda5dbeb779)

**Tasks**

- Carry an affinity weapon and supported Zoan fruit

**Rewards**

- Doriki +210, Belly +8,500

<a id="q-1990fd43d6a0ff95"></a>

## Steel Comes Alive

Carry an actually infused weapon. Affinity alone is not an infusion. Its stored fruit must be recognized by Infusion.

Existing infused weapons also count. The quest never consumes your weapon.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [A Fruit for the Forge](special_weapons.md#q-30665e46db07dcbe)

**Tasks**

- Carry an infused weapon

**Rewards**

- Doriki +420, Belly +24,500

<a id="q-5a680998ef542622"></a>

## Fight as One

Defeat 25 hostile non-player enemies with direct melee attacks while holding an infused weapon.

Only kills after this quest becomes startable count. Summon, projectile and indirect kills do not count. Weak passive creatures and PvP are excluded.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Steel Comes Alive](special_weapons.md#q-1990fd43d6a0ff95)

**Tasks**

- Defeat 25 hostiles in infused-weapon melee

**Rewards**

- Doriki +420, Belly +24,500

## A Beast at Your Side

**Optional quest.**

Only a summon owned by you counts. Choose a supported fruit with a companion form; other fruit choices can skip this optional branch.
